title: Design System: Crossroads Custom Apparel — The Manifest Line & The Gear Drop

shadows.name: console
shadows.purpose: Default panel elevation on the console system — .console-panel.

shadows.name: nav-rail-glow
shadows.purpose: Console sidebar's one signature glow — the active route's left rail.

shadows.name: tag
shadows.purpose: Gear Drop default paper elevation — .tag-card and .crate-panel at rest.

shadows.name: stamp
shadows.purpose: Gear Drop primary-button and stamp-badge elevation — reads as a rubber stamp pressed onto paper.

overlayScale.purpose: White-alpha overlays on the console system, graduated by emphasis: 0.03/0.04 (subtle fill), 0.06 (default border/divider), 0.08 (panel border), 0.10 (hover fill/skeleton highlight), 0.14 (hover border), 0.22 (sheen highlight peak). The Gear Drop system uses ink-alpha shadows instead (see the tag/tag-hover/stamp shadow entries) rather than a white overlay scale, since its ground is light.

motion.name: expo-out
motion.purpose: Standard entrance easing for staggered reveals on both systems.

motion.name: signal-pulse
motion.purpose: Console-only: a KPI icon ring pulsing while it reports real, current urgency.

motion.name: ambient-drift
motion.purpose: Shared grammar, different palette: two slow glow orbs behind every canvas on both systems — cyan/green on the console, marigold/teal on the Gear Drop.

motion.name: crate-lid-reveal
motion.value: rotateX 0→-115deg, opacity 1→0, 0.85s cubic-bezier(0.6,0.02,0.15,1), transform-origin top center
motion.purpose: Gear Drop landing hero only: the one-time signature reveal, a crate lid tipping open on load. Never repeated elsewhere in the system.

motion.name: twine-draw
motion.purpose: Gear Drop: the dashed twine line connecting sequential steps (currently landing's How-It-Works) draws in once, desktop only.

motion.name: stamp-thud
motion.purpose: Gear Drop .stencil-btn press feedback — reads as a physical stamp landing, not just a color change.

components.name: Console Panel
components.description: The base dark surface for every grouped block of content on Admin/Login — KPI tile, order manifest, quick actions.
components.css: .ds-console-panel { background:#12151b; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius:0.5rem; color:#e3e5e9; font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; }

components.name: Console Primary Button
components.description: Admin/Login's one interactive accent — cyan fill, near-black text for contrast.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#33e1ff; color:#0a0c10; font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',Inter,sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:0.875rem; padding:0.5rem 1rem; border:none; border-radius:0.375rem; cursor:pointer; transition:background 0.2s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#a7f3ff; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #33e1ff; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Signal Lamp
components.description: Admin status indicator — a colored dot plus its label, never a filled pill. Exactly four states.
components.css: .ds-lamp { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.375rem; font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',Inter,sans-serif; font-size:0.75rem; font-weight:500; } .ds-lamp-dot { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:9999px; flex-shrink:0; } .ds-lamp-amber { color:#ffb238; } .ds-lamp-amber .ds-lamp-dot { background:#ffb238; }

components.name: KPI Stat Tile
components.description: Admin instrument-style metric readout — uppercase label, icon chip, tabular-mono value.
components.html:
Total Revenue$

components.css: .ds-stat { background:#12151b; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius:0.5rem; padding:1.25rem; font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-stat-head { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; margin-bottom:0.875rem; } .ds-stat-label { font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#9aa0ac; } .ds-stat-icon { width:2rem; height:2rem; border-radius:0.5rem; background:rgba(51,225,255,0.10); color:#33e1ff; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:0.875rem; } .ds-stat-value { font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-weight:600; font-size:1.5rem; color:#ffffff; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Admin active route gets a glowing cyan left rail — the sidebar's one load-bearing signature glow.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.75rem; padding:0.625rem 0.75rem; border-radius:0.5rem; font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',Inter,sans-serif; font-size:0.8125rem; font-weight:500; color:#9aa0ac; position:relative; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-item-active { color:#eaf9ff; background:rgba(51,225,255,0.09); } .ds-nav-item-active::before { content:''; position:absolute; left:-0.75rem; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); width:2px; height:18px; background:#33e1ff; box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(51,225,255,0.7); }

components.name: Gear Drop Primary Button
components.description: Storefront's one loud action — a stencil-red gradient with a stamped-thud press and a one-time sheen sweep on hover.
components.css: .ds-stencil-btn { background:linear-gradient(180deg,#CB4A35 0%,#A82F1E 100%); color:#FBF6EC; font-family:'Barlow',system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:0.875rem; padding:0.5rem 1.25rem; border:1px solid rgba(42,32,21,0.15); border-radius:0.625rem; box-shadow:0 1px 1px rgba(42,32,21,0.25),0 3px 8px rgba(42,32,21,0.18); cursor:pointer; transition:transform 0.15s,box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-stencil-btn:hover { background:linear-gradient(180deg,#D65940 0%,#BE3B27 100%); transform:translateY(-1px); box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(42,32,21,0.16),0 18px 32px -8px rgba(42,32,21,0.30); } .ds-stencil-btn:active { transform:translateY(1px) scale(0.98); }

components.name: Tag Card
components.description: The Gear Drop's signature object for a product or shop preview — a kraft luggage tag with a punched hole, scattered tilt, straightens and lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-tag-card { position:relative; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#F2E4C6 0%,#E9D6AC 100%); border:1px solid #DEC9A0; border-radius:0.625rem; padding:1.25rem; color:#2A2015; font-family:'Barlow',system-ui,sans-serif; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(42,32,21,0.14),0 8px 18px -6px rgba(42,32,21,0.22); transform:rotate(-0.7deg); transition:transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-tag-card:hover { transform:rotate(0deg) translateY(-4px); box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(42,32,21,0.16),0 20px 36px -8px rgba(42,32,21,0.30); } .ds-tag-hole { position:absolute; top:-7px; left:20px; width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:9999px; background:#F8F1E1; border:1.5px solid #C7AD7C; }

components.name: Crate Panel — Manifest Ticket
components.description: The Gear Drop's flat structured-content surface: multi-item content divided by dashed tear-lines, replacing the same-size-icon-card grid the craft floor refuses.
components.html:
Screen Printing — vibrant, durable prints
Embroidery — clean, professional stitching
components.css: .ds-crate-panel { background:linear-gradient(180deg,#F2E4C6 0%,#ECD9B2 100%); border:1px solid #DEC9A0; border-radius:0.75rem; overflow:hidden; font-family:'Barlow',system-ui,sans-serif; color:#2A2015; } .ds-ticket-row { padding:1.5rem; } .ds-ticket-row + .ds-ticket-row { border-top:1px dashed #C7AD7C; }

components.name: Stamp Badge
components.description: A rubber ink-stamp mark for status/urgency — Space Mono, outlined, permanently rotated like it landed slightly crooked.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-weight:700; font-size:0.6875rem; letter-spacing:0.05em; text-transform:uppercase; padding:0.25rem 0.55rem; border-radius:0.3rem; border:1.5px solid #BE3B27; color:#BE3B27; background:rgba(190,59,39,0.10); transform:rotate(-1.5deg); }

narrative.northStar: The Manifest Line (Admin & Login) & The Gear Drop (Public Storefront)
narrative.overview: Two systems, split by mode. Admin and Login read as a live dispatch floor: near-black graphite panels, four disciplined instrument signals (cyan/green/amber/red), real layered depth, two ambient glow fields, hover-lift everywhere. Unchanged by this revision. Landing, Group Shops, and Checkout read as the shop's own fulfillment made visible — a packed gear crate on a sunlit workbench, not a software product grid and not the console's night dispatch bay. Warm kraft/cardboard grounds, four stencil-ink accents (barn red/marigold/teal/forest green), every product or shop tile a punched-hole kraft tag at a scattered tilt, structured content as a flat manifest-ticket panel with dashed tear-lines rather than same-size icon cards, a dashed twine line stringing sequential steps together, a crate lid that tips open once on the landing hero's load. Allerta Stencil display, Barlow body, Space Mono data — deliberately a different stack from the console's IBM Plex. Chosen through a structured direction round (seed key 8bfab481, assigned candidate 6 of 7) after the user reported the console world felt 'lifeless and bleak' applied to the public storefront.
keyCharacteristics: Two systems, enforced in code by AdminShell's isPublic branch — they never mix on one page
Console: near-black graphite grounds, four locked signal colors, IBM Plex Mono for data
Console: two slow ambient glow fields (cyan/green), sharp 6-8px radii, hover-lift everywhere
Gear Drop: warm kraft grounds, never white/black, four expressive stencil accents
Gear Drop: punched-hole tag cards at a scattered tilt for anything selectable; flat manifest-ticket panels for structured content
Gear Drop: Allerta Stencil display / Barlow body / Space Mono data — a different type stack on purpose
Gear Drop: one unrepeated signature moment — the landing hero's crate-lid reveal

rules.name: The Locked Palette Rule
rules.body: Console only: a signal color never appears for decoration — only to report the specific state it's assigned to.

rules.name: The Graphite-300 Floor Rule
rules.body: Console only: no real text drops below graphite-300 (≈7.5:1) on the graphite-950 canvas; graphite-400 is icon-only.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Data Rule
rules.body: Console only: IBM Plex Mono is reserved for numbers, dates, IDs, and status words.

rules.name: The Earned Glow Rule
rules.body: Console only: glow and gradient answer to something real — a primary action, genuine urgency, or the app's own ambience.

rules.name: The Crate-Ink-Soft Floor Rule
rules.body: Gear Drop only: no real text drops below crate-ink-soft, including inside a .crate-panel/.tag-card's deeper gradient tone; crate-ink-faint is icon-only.

rules.name: The Gold-Carries-Dark-Text Rule
rules.body: Gear Drop only: stencil-gold is the one accent too light for paper-cream text; anything on a gold fill uses crate-ink.

rules.name: The Ticket-Means-Data Rule
rules.body: Gear Drop only: Space Mono is reserved for prices, counts, dates, and SKUs.

rules.name: The Stencil-Is-Display-Only Rule
rules.body: Gear Drop only: Allerta Stencil never drops below section-headline size; body, labels, and buttons are always Barlow.

rules.name: The Tag-vs-Ticket Rule
rules.body: Gear Drop only: tilt and the punched hole are reserved for .tag-card (things a visitor selects); structured content is always a flat .crate-panel.

dos: Do keep every console signal color tied to its one real meaning
Do render console data in IBM Plex Mono and Gear Drop data in Space Mono, both tabular-nums
Do keep the Gear Drop ground warm kraft — never white, never the console's near-black
Do recompose multi-item storefront content as one manifest ticket with dashed tear-lines, never three same-size icon cards
donts: Don't add a fifth console accent color
Don't use a colored border-left/border-right accent above 1px on any panel or row, on either system
Don't use console tokens (IBM Plex, signal-*, graphite-*) anywhere on the Gear Drop, or Gear Drop tokens anywhere on the console
Don't put a kicker/eyebrow label above a heading on either system — craft-floor ban, no exception
Don't use crate-ink-faint for real text — icon-only, same discipline as the console's graphite-400 rule
